entries.label: Très légère
entries.description: Very light service outfit: a slim exposed dark gunmetal robotic ribcage and narrow mechanical limbs, a tiny sleeveless ivory protective textile vest with short dark navy side tabs; exposed upper arms and thighs are clearly artificial metal, not skin. entries.label: Très lourde
entries.description: Very heavy machine-priest armor: a fully enclosed ivory industrial exoshell over the same robotic frame, broad squared shoulder blocks, a large solid chest housing with one small amber power indicator, reinforced closed gauntlets, broad continuous thigh and shin housings and heavy flat mechanical boots. A short dark navy split tech-tabard visible behind the hips. Clearly the heaviest tier but more angular and slimmer than a hulking melee warrior. One large form per body segment; deep readable dark hinge gaps. No gun, no tools, no antenna, no extra arms, no spikes, no extra backpack projections.
entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: headless full-body armor sprite for a 64x64 native roguelike cell.
Input 1 is the Technomancien's previous very-heavy armor, which reads too slim and medium-weight at final size. Input 2 is a simplification reference ONLY, not the human body anatomy.
Make input 1 unambiguously VERY HEAVY by adding thick LARGE ivory industrial armor housings around the same robotic frame. This is the fifth final tier: MUCH wider shoulder blocks, one broad nearly solid square chest housing, thick broad forearm gauntlet housings, large continuous hip/thigh shells and very broad thick enclosed boots. Fill most exposed rib-like subdivisions with a few clean large armor shapes. Preserve simple dark elbow, waist and knee hinges so the robotic nature remains obvious.
